section.about.title: About me
section.about.description1: Throughout my 15-year career, I've evolved from building desktop applications to architecting cloud-based solutions. My journey has taken me from analyzing business requirements to architecting complex systems, but what truly drives me is the intersection of technology and creativity.
section.about.description2: Beyond professional development, I'm deeply passionate about game 🕹️ prototyping and development. There's something magical about bringing interactive experiences to life whether I'm experimenting with new gameplay mechanics. This creative outlet keeps my problem-solving skills sharp and my enthusiasm for technology burning bright.
section.about.description3: When I step away from the screen, you'll find me on running trails, where I find mental clarity. I also love spending time training my dog 🐕‍🦺, which has surprisingly taught me valuable lessons about patience, consistency, and clear communication skills that translate beautifully to software development and team collaboration.

project.snap.title: Snap To Table - AI Recipe Generator
project.snap.description: Developed a full-stack AI application to generate recipes from food pictures. Implemented a robust backend using .NET, CQRS, and Clean Architecture to handle image processing and AI model interaction. Created a responsive, cross-platform user experience using React Native.
